headline: Spain and Belgium Set for Epic Quarter-Final Showdown
whyCareReason: A blockbuster Quarter-Final fixture in Los Angeles with a place in the next round on the line.
teaser: With Group QF wide open, both Spain and Belgium view this fixture as a must-win game. Here is what to watch for.
story:
Football fans around the world are looking forward to 2026-07-10, when Spain and Belgium will go head-to-head in Los Angeles. The match promises to be a showcase of tactical discipline and individual skill.

The clash of styles makes this game particularly intriguing. The structural discipline of Spain will be tested by the fluid attacking movements of Belgium, with Lamine Yamal and Kevin De Bruyne expected to play central roles in their respective strategies.

The fans are already gathering in Los Angeles, creating a wonderful festival atmosphere. Regardless of the outcome, this promises to be a classic chapter in their footballing history.
stakes: In the Quarter-Final, there is no room for error. A single loss means the end of the World Cup dream for either Spain or Belgium.
rivalryAngle: The footballing connection between Spain and Belgium adds an extra layer of emotion to this fixture, making it a must-watch for fans.
funFacts: Spain are affectionately known as the La Roja.
Belgium are affectionately known as the Red Devils.
This high-profile match was held at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles on 2026-07-10.

keyPlayers.hook: The key playmaker leading the tactical setup for the La Roja.

keyPlayers.name: Kevin De Bruyne
keyPlayers.hook: The creative spark expected to make the difference for the Red Devils.
